question: Does inference-aligned validation policy loss order agree with observed searchless play for raw BT4, Hero1 and history-trained HH-002?

evaluation.primary_pool: 8128 retained original Hero validation positions, frozen HH-002 selection
evaluation.policies: Raw native policy; each learned checkpoint native policy, DFM one pass and DFM eight passes
evaluation.metric: Mean legal-conditional cross-entropy of actual played next move in nats; lower is better
evaluation.inference: Capture first/eighth root logits from unchanged arena refinement helper, all tokens initially masked, no teacher forcing; check selected action parity
evaluation.history: Each checkpoint uses its recorded training contract; common boards/targets/legal masks
evaluation.excluded: No training, new games, composite JEPA/value objectives, randomly teacher-forced DFM metrics, or checkpoint selection

analysis.comparison: Descriptive policy-loss ordering versus already observed BT4 game scores, and matched HH-002 p8 versus p1 contrast; report missing edges explicitly
analysis.limitations: Validation pools are reused development data, not newly held-out strength tests. Played moves are not certified optimal. Positions can be correlated; no IID position confidence claims. CE measures probabilities/calibration, while greedy play uses argmax and compounds rare mistakes. Association is not causation or a guarantee of monotonic Elo.
analysis.reproducibility_check: Compare repeated Hero1 current-only sequential native and one-pass results against EV-003

budget.rule: Refresh live spend before each launch; use the larger of live spend and conservative reservation floor, adding the full CPU reservation before GPU. Verify all consumed input bytes on CPU before GPU allocation.
